questions.question: Read the passage carefully and answer the following questions: In recent times, the diplomatic and economic relations between China and India, two of Asia’s largest powers, have shown signs of significant improvement. This shift in their historic rivalry has been notably influenced by the introduction of new tariff policies by the United States. The US tariffs on Chinese goods have created economic pressures that have propelled China to reconsider and recalibrate its foreign relations strategy. India, being a key player in global trade and geopolitics, has emerged as an important partner in this development. The US tariffs, aimed primarily at curbing China’s dominance in global manufacturing, inadvertently boosted India’s appeal as an alternative manufacturing hub. As companies sought to circumvent the high tariffs imposed on Chinese products, many began exploring India for investment opportunities and as a new production base. This economic realignment provided a pragmatic foundation for the two neighbouring giants to ease tensions and enhance cooperation. Several high-level dialogues were initiated, focusing on trade facilitation, border dispute resolutions, and regional security. Both nations recognized the mutual benefits of stabilizing their relationship to capitalize on emerging economic opportunities fostered by shifting global trade dynamics. Furthermore, India’s strategic position within the US-led Indo-Pacific framework has encouraged China to engage more constructively to avoid isolation. While historical mistrust and geopolitical rivalries persist, the recent US tariff-induced economic pressures have become a catalyst for China and India to mend fences. This evolving partnership is expected to have significant implications, not only for bilateral ties but also for broader regional and global economic landscapes. What has recently influenced the improvement in China-India relations?
